summary: Versioned minimal, full, and benchmark packaging is reproducible, non-root, runtime-secret-only, fresh-machine tested, and backed by current fail-closed SPDX/SARIF evidence for all nine images.
scopeExpansion: The delivery necessarily includes lockfiles, smoke/evidence scripts, and operator documentation in agent-harnesses, langgraph-agent, scripts, and docs. These files directly implement the pinned-dependency, SBOM, fresh-machine, and documentation acceptance criteria; unrelated user changes were preserved.

acceptanceEvidence.versionedPinnedImages: All images have release tags. Node, Python, and MCP Gateway bases use immutable digests. The rebuilt root image uses Debian snapshot 20260701T000000Z and live dpkg-query confirms ca-certificates=20230311+deb12u1, git=1:2.39.5-0+deb12u3, and python3=3.11.2-1+b1. All seven Python dependency graphs are complete transitive lockfiles with hashes and Docker builds use pip --require-hashes.
acceptanceEvidence.profiles: Compose validation passed for minimal (4 services), full (5 services), and benchmark (11 services). A complete benchmark-profile build finished with exit 0 after the final source state.
acceptanceEvidence.nonRootAndSecrets: The current nine image IDs inspect as web=node and every other image=65532:65532. The build context excludes environment, secret, artifact, workspace, and cache paths. The aggregate gate scans non-truncated histories for secret markers and rejects root/default users.
acceptanceEvidence.freshMachine: The isolated project conductor-fresh-8f216da496e4 passed in 31.7 seconds against the rebuilt versioned web image: all four minimal services became healthy and non-root, /portal returned 200, /api/models honestly returned agent_provider_unconfigured with zero ready providers, and teardown removed the project's containers, volumes, and networks.
acceptanceEvidence.sbomAndVulnerabilities: artifacts/container-evidence/summary.json has complete=true and nine passed entries. Every entry has a current matching image ID plus parseable, non-empty inspect, history, SPDX SBOM, and SARIF vulnerability artifacts. The web entry binds image sha256:a706c4dbb368d6378039f42cca1e67ab72ed69ecd57bb73ccfc10a93dca75e95 to reviewed source digest 4c81cc603c6eea8b2eb096566dbe6b9e480f2e9dd8eb727492a551a2b312339b; aggregate-only recomputes and enforces this binding. Per-image unique Docker Scout cache directories prevent cross-scan contention; aggregate-only validation fails closed for stale or missing evidence.
acceptanceEvidence.ciSupplyChain: The CI workflow pins checkout, setup-buildx, and upload-artifact to immutable commit SHAs, fails when evidence files are missing, and executes the same fail-closed scan and fresh-machine smoke gates.

checks.summary: The required base check passed. Separate minimal, full, and benchmark --profile config --quiet checks also passed with 4, 5, and 11 services respectively.

Production build passed; 117 application tests passed, 0 failed, 1 opt-in live harness test skipped; companion tests passed 18/18.
